brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces killed 12 Palestinians over two days in a series of attacks across Gaza, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The dead included three children, a woman, and an elderly man. Twenty-one others sustained injuries in the strikes, which targeted civilian vehicles, gatherings, homes, tents, and other civilian facilities throughout the territory.

The killings represent a continuation of the violence that has devastated Gaza's civilian population in recent months. The documented toll underscores the mounting casualties among Palestinians from Israeli military operations in the enclave.
dek: Over the past two days, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR) documented the killing of 12 Palestinians, including three children, a woman, and an elderly man, and the injury of 21 others in a wave of attacks by the Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) targeting civilian vehicles, gatherings, homes, tents, and other civilian facilities.
title: Israel kills 12 Palestinians in Gaza including children and elderly
